about: The eval set (OPUS_DESIGN2 T1, OPUS_PLAN Day 0): pages from real client books, each with why it is here and its ground truth.
Page numbers are pages of the built file: for an Accessible PDF the cover is page 1, as in the client's finished file; for an EPUB book they are pages of the print PDF.
test/reference-score.ts scores reading order and caption/heading F1 on these pages for every book with a finished reference PDF.
The client files themselves are never in git (fixtures/reference, corrections/).
